title: Was I in Mall World?
content: I had a dream that I was leaving a mall but wanted to stop into one store before I left. It was like a Hot Topic on steroids. It was just me and the manager. He gave me a short tour and the store got larger and larger and at one point I felt some invisible entity push at me and it really scared me. I called on my higher self for help and nothing happened; I couldn’t fight back. It always left this unsettling impression on me, so hearing about mall world really piques my interest. Any thoughts?
